title: Client to server websocket message
description: Every frame the browser sends on /ws. The connection is already authenticated by the ticket presented during the handshake, so no message carries credentials.

topic.description: A stream the client wants. `snapshots:<SYMBOL>` follows one underlying; `snapshots:*` follows every symbol the server publishes. Symbols are upper case, matching the instrument catalog.

correlationId.description: Opaque client-chosen id. Echoed on the matching `ack` or `error` so a client can tie a reply to its request. Optional — a client that does not correlate may omit it.

topics.description: Topics to add. Already-subscribed topics are accepted and ignored, so a client may resend its full set after a reconnect without tracking what the server holds.
Topics to drop. Topics not currently held are accepted and ignored.

ping.description: Application-level liveness check, answered with `pong`. Distinct from the protocol-level ping uvicorn already sends: this one proves the application loop — not just the socket — is still reading.
